brief: Holds a polynomial in one variable, evaluates and differentiates it, adds and multiplies, and finds its real and complex roots.
detail: Coefficients are written highest degree first, the way the polynomial is written: [1, -6, 11, -6] is x^3 - 6x^2 + 11x - 6, and leading zeros are dropped. The roots are the eigenvalues of the companion matrix, computed by the engine, so a root repeated m times comes back as a small cluster rather than exactly (the tolerance of RealRoots and RealRootsWithin is how that is surfaced). Plus, Minus, Times and the Derivative return coefficient lists and the Q forms return a new stzPolynomial; none of them changes the object. Checked by hand: x^3 - 6x^2 + 11x - 6 has the roots 1, 2, 3, value 6 at 4, derivative 3x^2 - 12x + 11 and, times x - 1, the product x^4 - 7x^3 + 17x^2 - 17x + 6; x^2 + 1 has the roots i and -i.
